standard: Claims in an ACORD-style property and casualty layout; ledger in a simplified ACH, wire and card layout; aid applications, awards and invoices as plain tables
notes: Nine CSV files produced by scripts/streams/gen_finance.py. No column says which records are improper; findings come from joining the files to each other and to entity_registry.json, organizations.json and areas.json. Dates without a time are local calendar dates; timestamps are UTC.
entity_catalog: 06_data_streams/entity_registry.json (insurers, brokers, appraisers, adjusters, vendors, contracts, banks, accounts, policyholders, policies, merchants); organisations in organizations.json

insurance_claims.description: Policy transactions (new business, renewals, endorsements) from mid-July 2027, property claims after Hurricane Rafael, and oil-spill damage claims lodged at the claims centre.
insurance_claims.sampling: Property claims are the claims on the 1,904 policies in entity_registry.json: about 0.6 percent (1 in 170) of the roughly 187,000 claims and $2.1 billion reported for the three counties by Oct. 14, so totals scale by about 170. Spill claims are complete (about 4,200).

record_types.policy_transaction: transaction_id, transaction_type, transaction_date, prior/new replacement cost value, county assessed value, appraisal order fields
record_types.claim: claim_id, claim_program ('property insurance' or 'oil spill claims centre (Oil Pollution Act)'), loss, filing, adjuster, estimate, payment and status fields

key_fields.name: policy_id
key_fields.notes: policies[].policy_number in entity_registry.json; empty for spill claims

key_fields.name: insurer_id / broker_id / appraiser_id / adjuster_id / holder_id
key_fields.notes: entity_registry.json

key_fields.name: loss_date
key_fields.notes: never before 2027-09-14

key_fields.name: filed_date
key_fields.notes: first notice of loss; rises from landfall, few in the first two days

key_fields.name: latitude / longitude
key_fields.notes: point beside the street in property_address, on land (property claims only)

key_fields.name: contractor_estimate_supplier_id
key_fields.notes: vendors[].vendor_id of the contractor whose estimate supports the claim

key_fields.name: estimate_document_id / damage_narrative_id / photo_ids
key_fields.notes: document and image identifiers; the same identifier on different claims means the same document or photograph

key_fields.name: payment_account_id
key_fields.notes: insurer's disbursement account; the payment appears in financial_transactions.csv with the claim id as reference

aid_applications.description: FEMA Individual Assistance under DR-4821-TX: one row per event. Registration opened 2027-11-13T00:00Z (public launch Saturday Nov. 13).

record_types.application: submitted_utc, channel (web, phone, recovery centre, door-to-door), source address and device for web and kiosk submissions, household and damage fields, deposit details
record_types.determination: decision with assistance_type, amount_usd and status
record_types.disbursement: payment to the deposit account on file at that time; status paid or reissued
record_types.account_change: changed_utc, field_changed, the login that preceded it (login_utc, login_ip_seen_before Y/N), new and previous deposit details

key_fields.name: application_id
key_fields.notes: IA-4821-nnnnnnn

key_fields.name: account_id
key_fields.notes: applicant portal account

key_fields.name: area_id / tract
key_fields.notes: areas.json: AREA-TRACT-<tract> for Nueces County, AREA-CITY-* for San Patricio and Aransas counties

key_fields.name: deposit_routing_number / deposit_account_masked
key_fields.notes: join to financial_institutions[].routing_number and accounts[].account_number_masked in entity_registry.json

key_fields.name: source_asn
key_fields.notes: autonomous system of the source address

financial_transactions.description: Ledger of the 104 accounts in entity_registry.json (vendors' business accounts and insurers' claim disbursement accounts), 2027-08-15 to 2028-01-12, with running balance.

key_fields.name: account_id
key_fields.notes: accounts[].account_id

key_fields.name: counterparty_id
key_fields.notes: another registry account, an organisation (ORG-*), a card merchant (MER-*), an exchange endpoint (CRYPTO-*), or empty for individuals

key_fields.name: merchant_city
key_fields.notes: city of the merchant for card purchases

key_fields.name: reference
key_fields.notes: invoice payment reference, claim id or aid application id

files.contracts_vendor_registry.csv: vendor registrations: supplier_id, UEI, address, registration date, bank account and alternate account
files.contracts_business_filings.csv: state formation filings for the vendors and, from the day they were filed, court filings that concern them
files.contracts_awards.csv: award records: piid, awarding body, supplier, value, procurement method, offers received, period, funding
files.contracts_invoices.csv: invoices with quantity, unit, unit price, work area, remit account, approval and payment dates, status
files.contracts_actions.csv: dated contract actions: modifications, remittance changes, deficiency reports, suspensions, payment holds
files.contracts_debris_monitoring.csv: the county's weekly debris estimates by zone from drone photogrammetry and satellite change detection, for comparison with billed tonnage

key_fields.name: supplier_id
key_fields.notes: vendors[].vendor_id

key_fields.name: piid
key_fields.notes: contracts[].contract_id; empty for small purchases, which carry po_number

key_fields.name: bank_account_id / remit_bank_account_id
key_fields.notes: accounts[].account_id

key_fields.name: work_area_id / area_id
key_fields.notes: areas.json

coverage.contracts: vendor registrations from 2005; awards, invoices and actions 2027-07-16 to 2028-01-11
